Microphone audio is analysed locally and never leaves your device. Cloud sync is optional and off by default — if you enable it and sign in with Google, your songs/history/progress sync to a private folder in your own Google Drive (minimal drive.appdata scope, plus your name and email so this page can show which account is connected); sign out anytime. Otherwise your data lives only in this browser.
